2011-cloze-1.explain: despite some claims to the contrary 意为“尽管有一些相反的说法”，介词 despite 后接名词短语，与后半句 probably has little influence 构成让步关系。among 表范围，except 表排除，like 表比较，都不能引导让步。
2011-cloze-1.trap: B except 与 despite 形近，且都可译成“除……”，但 except 表示排除在外，不表让步；此处需要“尽管”。

2011-cloze-2.explain: produce short-term changes 表示“产生短期变化”，与 changes 搭配自然，主语是笑这一动作，强调它造成的结果。reflect 的主语通常是数据、迹象等，indicate 多指“表明某一事实”，demand 与 changes 不搭配。
2011-cloze-2.trap: A reflect 看似可译“反映出变化”，但 reflect changes 的主语往往是被观察对象，而不是“笑”这一生理动作；此处强调笑“造成”变化。

2011-cloze-3.explain: 现在分词 boosting 作结果状语，具体说明短期变化的表现：使心率和耗氧量上升。stabilizing“使稳定”、impairing“损害”、determining“决定”都与 heart rate and oxygen consumption 的生理变化方向不符。
2011-cloze-3.trap: C impairing 与“变化”搭配也说得通，但使心率“受损”不合生理常识；此处说的是心率上升。

2011-cloze-4.explain: hard laughter is difficult to sustain 意为“大笑难以持续”，sustain 与 laughter 搭配表示“维持、持续”，正是后文“不能像散步那样带来可测量益处”的原因。transmit“传递”、evaluate“评估”、observe“观察”都不能与 laughter 构成这一语义。
2011-cloze-4.trap: D observe 可接“笑”，但主语是 hard laughter，成了“大笑难以观察”，与上下文因果链无关；A transmit 更不能与 laughter 搭配。

2011-cloze-5.explain: measurable benefits 指“可测量的益处”，与 walking or jogging 这类效果可量化的运动形成对比。manageable、affordable、renewable 与 benefits 搭配都不表“可量化”。
2011-cloze-5.trap: B manageable 与 measurable 形近，但意为“可控制的、可应付的”，不能修饰 benefits 表示“可测量的益处”。

2011-cloze-6.explain: 上文说笑对体质影响甚微，本句进一步指出笑的作用与锻炼“相反”，用 In fact 对上文加以确认和推进。In turn 表顺承或轮流，In addition 表补充，In brief 表总结。
2011-cloze-6.trap: A In turn 常被误当成“反过来”，但它表示“依次、转而”，不能引出对前句的进一步证实。

2011-cloze-7.explain: accomplishes the opposite 意为“起到相反的作用”，与前半句 instead of straining muscles to build them 形成对照：锻炼绷紧肌肉以增强，笑却放松肌肉。
2011-cloze-7.trap: D expected 若填 the expected，意为“预料之中的事”，与 instead of 的转折语气相冲突。

2011-cloze-8.explain: relaxes muscles 与后文 decreasing muscle tone 同义复现，说明笑使肌肉放松、张力下降。hardens、tightens 方向相反，weakens 指“使虚弱”，不指肌肉松弛。
2011-cloze-8.trap: B weakens 也可说“使肌肉无力”，但对应 decreasing muscle tone（张力下降）的准确表达是 relax；“变弱”不等于“放松”。

2011-cloze-9.explain: moderate the effects of psychological stress 意为“缓和心理压力的影响”，与 might conceivably help 的推测语气一致。aggravate“加剧”、enhance“增强”方向相反；generate 与 effects 搭配是“产生作用”，而“帮助产生压力影响”不合逻辑。
2011-cloze-9.trap: A aggravate 与 moderate 语义相反，若只看到 help 容易误选；help 后接动词原形，并不决定语义方向。

2011-cloze-10.explain: other types of physical feedback 指“其他类型的身体反馈”，与前文 bodily reaction、heart rate 等生理变化呼应，也与 emotional state 形成“身体—情绪”的对照。
2011-cloze-10.trap: B mental 与 emotional state 语义重复，且“心理反馈”不如“身体反馈”贴合上文；D internal 过于笼统。

2011-cloze-11.explain: According to one classical theory of emotion 意为“根据一种经典的情绪理论”，引出下文的理论依据。Except for、Due to、As for 都不能这样引出观点来源。
2011-cloze-11.trap: C Due to 表原因，填进去成了“由于一种理论”，把依据说成了原因，逻辑倒置。

2011-cloze-12.explain: be rooted in 是固定搭配，意为“扎根于、源于”，our feelings are partially rooted in physical reactions 即“我们的感受部分源于身体反应”。
2011-cloze-12.trap: B on 受 root“在……上”的汉语联想干扰，但英语固定搭配是 rooted in。

2011-cloze-13.explain: do not cry because they are sad 意为“不是因为悲伤才哭”，because 引导原因状语从句；后文 but they become sad when the tears begin to flow 给出相反的因果顺序。unless、until、if 都不表原因。
2011-cloze-13.trap: C if 会使句意变成“如果他们悲伤就不哭”，与“因果倒置”这一主题不符；还要注意 not 否定的范围是 because 从句。

2011-cloze-14.explain: Although sadness also precedes tears 意为“尽管悲伤也会先于眼泪”，即承认悲伤能引起流泪；这与后文“情绪也可以源自肌肉反应”构成让步转折。
2011-cloze-14.trap: B follows 方向相反，若填 follows 就成了“悲伤跟随眼泪”，与 although 引出的让步逻辑相冲突。

2011-cloze-15.explain: flow from muscular responses 意为“源自肌肉反应”，flow from 表示“来自、由……产生”，与上文 rooted in physical reactions 相呼应，说明情绪的来源。
2011-cloze-15.trap: A into 方向相反，成了“情绪流入肌肉反应”；此处强调的是来源而非去向。

2011-cloze-16.explain: hold a pen either with their teeth or with their lips 意为“用牙齿或嘴唇衔住一支笔”，hold 表示使某物保持在某一位置。fetch“去取”、bite“咬”、pick“挑选”都不能准确描述这一实验动作。
2011-cloze-16.trap: B bite 似与“用牙”呼应，但 bite a pen 是“咬笔”，而实验要求用牙齿“衔住”笔以牵动笑肌，hold 更准确。

2011-cloze-17.explain: 用嘴唇含笔会使嘴部肌肉收紧、嘴角下垂，产生 a disappointed expression“失望的表情”，与前面 artificial smile 形成对照，也为下文 frown 作铺垫。
2011-cloze-17.trap: C joyful 与 artificial smile 同向，无法构成对照；B excited 也不符合嘴唇含笔时的面部形态。

2011-cloze-18.explain: reacted more enthusiastically to funny cartoons 意为“对滑稽动画片反应更热烈”，react to 是固定搭配。adapted to 是“适应”，catered to 是“迎合”，turned to 是“求助于”，均不合实验语境。
2011-cloze-18.trap: C turned 与 to 连用是“转向、求助”，不能表示“对……作出反应”；A adapted to 意为“适应”，与“更热烈”不搭。

2011-cloze-19.explain: 现在分词 suggesting 作结果状语，意为“这表明”，引出实验结论：表情可能影响情绪。requiring、mentioning、supposing 都不能引出由实验得出的结论。
2011-cloze-19.trap: D supposing 是“假设”，会把已经完成的实验结果降格为假定；此处需要表示“表明”的 suggest。

2011-cloze-20.explain: 前文说表情可以影响情绪，末句由此类推到笑这一身体动作也能改善心情，用 Similarly 表示类比。Eventually 表时间，Consequently 表因果，Conversely 表相反。
2011-cloze-20.trap: B Consequently 似可表因果，但此处是由实验结果“类推”到笑的整体作用，并非严格因果；D Conversely 方向相反。

2011-text1-21.explain:
正确项：received acclaim. the response has been favorable 直接说明任命得到正面反响，严肃评论家也高呼 “Hooray! At last!”；received acclaim 准确概括“广受赞誉”。
其他选项：A. incurred criticism.：与原文相反。第一段强调反响正面，没有说任命招致批评。；B. raised suspicion.：偷换情绪。文章说任命突然且出人意料，不等于引起怀疑。；D. aroused curiosity.：把“成为话题”误解为“引发好奇”；决定性信息是 favorable 和欢呼式评价。
2011-text1-21.evidence:
For the most part, the response has been favorable, to say the least.
“Hooray! At last!” wrote Anthony Tommasini, a sober-sided classical-music critic.

2011-text1-22.explain:
正确项：modest. unpretentious 表示不炫耀、不摆架子，with no air of the formidable conductor 进一步说明他没有名指挥家的威严派头，正对应 modest。
其他选项：A. influential.：无中生有。文中没有评价他的影响力，反而说他相对不知名。；C. respectable.：评价过于宽泛，不能准确替换 unpretentious。；D. talented.：文中未用该引语判断其才华；作者随后甚至说自己不知道他是否算好指挥家。
2011-text1-22.evidence: Even Tommasini, who had advocated Gilbert's appointment in the *Times*, calls him “an unpretentious musician with no air of the formidable conductor about him.”

2011-text1-23.explain:
正确项：overestimate the value of live performances. 忠实听众强调现场不可替代，却忽略录音在价格、可获得性、艺术质量和使用便利性上的优势。作者说他们 are missing the point，表明他们高估了现场演出的相对价值。
其他选项：A. ignore the expenses of live performances.：范围缩小。费用只是作者列出的竞争维度之一，核心是听众整体高估现场价值。；B. reject most kinds of recorded performances.：程度扩大。原文只说他们认为录音不能替代现场，没有说拒绝大多数录音。；C. exaggerate the variety of live performances.：张冠李戴。曲目多样性出现在作者对吉尔伯特演出的让步评价中，并非忠实听众的观点。
2011-text1-23.evidence:
Devoted concertgoers who reply that recordings are no substitute for live performance are missing the point.
These recordings are cheap, available everywhere, and very often much higher in artistic quality than today's live performances; moreover, they can be “consumed” at a time and place of the listener's choosing.

2011-text1-24.explain:
正确项：They are easily accessible to the general public. cheap、available everywhere 以及可由听众自主选择时间地点，共同说明录音价格亲民、易于获得，即对一般公众而言很容易接触到。
其他选项：A. They are often inferior to live concerts in quality.：与原文相反；录音往往 much higher in artistic quality。；C. They help improve the quality of music.：偷换概念。原文比较录音与现场的质量，没有说录音会提升音乐质量。；D. They have only covered masterpieces.：绝对化且无中生有。文中提到 20 世纪大师的录音，但没有说录音只涵盖杰作。
2011-text1-24.evidence: These recordings are cheap, available everywhere, and very often much higher in artistic quality than today's live performances; moreover, they can be “consumed” at a time and place of the listener's choosing.

2011-text1-25.explain:
正确项：doubtful. 作者先坦言无法判断吉尔伯特是否优秀，随后质问所谓改变究竟是什么，并指出扩大曲目仍不够、成功还取决于重建观众关系。这一连串保留与条件体现的是怀疑态度。
其他选项：B. enthusiastic.：把他人赞誉误当作者态度。热烈评价来自托马西尼和罗斯，作者本人明显更审慎。；C. confident.：与作者的 I have no idea 及条件式表达不符。；D. puzzled.：作者不是无法理解发生了什么，而是怀疑吉尔伯特能否真正让乐团复兴；doubtful 更准确。
2011-text1-25.evidence:
For my part, I have no idea whether Gilbert is a great conductor or even a good one.
But what will be the nature of that difference?
Merely expanding the orchestra's repertoire will not be enough.
If Gilbert and the Philharmonic are to succeed, they must first change the relationship between America's oldest orchestra and the new audience it hopes to attract.

2011-text2-26.explain:
正确项：frank. straight up、rather than cloaking... 和 came right out and said 都强调麦吉没有用含糊借口掩饰，而是公开直说，因此其方式是坦率的。
其他选项：A. arrogant.：主观拔高。公开抱负不等于傲慢，文中没有自负或轻视他人的表现。；C. self-centered.：无中生有。文章谈的是表达方式直接，而非只顾自身利益。；D. impulsive.：没有证据表明决定冲动；very much my decision 强调自主决定，不是仓促决定。
2011-text2-26.evidence:
When Liam McGee departed as president of Bank of America in August, his explanation was surprisingly straight up.
Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said he was leaving “to pursue my goal of running a company.”

2011-text2-27.explain:
正确项：their pursuit of new career goals. 麦吉借离职表明执掌公司的抱负，另两家公司二号高管也为寻找 CEO 职位而辞职，未获继任资格的人则可能另谋出路；共同动因是追求新的职业目标。
其他选项：A. their expectation of better financial status.：无中生有。文中谈职位目标，没有谈薪酬或财务状况改善。；B. their need to reflect on their private life.：偷换对象。麦吉思考的是想经营哪类公司，不是私人生活。；C. their strained relations with the boards.：过度推断。未被选为继任者不等于与董事会关系紧张。
2011-text2-27.evidence:
It also sent a clear message to the outside world about his aspirations.
In recent weeks the No. 2 executives at Avon and American Express quit with the explanation that they were looking for a CEO post.
As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure, executives who don't get the nod also may wish to move on.

2011-text2-28.explain:
正确项：hunted for. 语境中的候选人是在职 CEO，董事会要求猎头先去寻找这些人并从其他公司挖来；poached 因而最接近“被猎寻、被挖掘”。
其他选项：A. approved of.：approve of 是赞同，不能体现跨公司争夺人才的动作。；B. attended to.：意为照料或处理，与猎头寻找候选人的语境不符。；D. guarded against.：意为提防，方向相反；公司希望招到这些人，而不是防范他们。
2011-text2-28.evidence: For years executives and headhunters have adhered to the rule that the most attractive CEO candidates are the ones who must be poached.

2011-text2-29.explain:
正确项：top performers used to cling to their posts. 过去的规则认为留在原职位更安全，离职待业还带有羞耻印记；这说明顶尖人才从前倾向于守住现职。如今规则反转，才使主动离职更可接受。
其他选项：B. loyalty of top performers is getting out-dated.：偷换概念。文章讨论风险观和待业污名变化，不是在否定“忠诚”这种品质。；C. top performers care more about reputations.：文中没有比较现在与过去谁更重视声誉；最后一段重点是留下太久可能受损。；D. it's safer to stick to the traditional rules.：与原文相反；传统规则已被 fundamentally inverted。
2011-text2-29.evidence:
Many recruiters say the old disgrace is fading for top performers.
“The traditional rule was it's safer to stay where you are, but that's been fundamentally inverted,” says one headhunter.
“The people who've been hurt the worst are those who've stayed too long.”

2011-text2-30.explain:
正确项：Top Managers Jump without a Net 全文围绕高管在尚无下家时主动离职展开，既分析其职业目标和经济背景，也讨论传统招聘规则、等待风险与新观念；Jump without a Net 正是文中反复使用的核心比喻。
其他选项：A. CEOs: Where to Go?：主体和重点都偏离。文章主角多是希望成为 CEO 的二号高管，重点是无下家离职，而非 CEO 去向。；B. CEOs: All the Way Up?：表意模糊，无法概括主动裸辞这一核心行为。；D. The Only Way Out for Top Performers：only 绝对化。文章介绍一种新趋势，并未说这是顶尖人才唯一出路。
2011-text2-30.evidence:
As the first signs of recovery begin to take hold, deputy chiefs may be more willing to make the jump without a net.
“The traditional rule was it's safer to stay where you are, but that's been fundamentally inverted,” says one headhunter.
“The people who've been hurt the worst are those who've stayed too long.”

2011-text3-31.explain:
正确项：enthusiastic about recommending their favorite products. passionate about a product 对应 enthusiastic，willingly promoting it to friends 对应主动向他人推荐喜爱的产品，因此消费者由此创造赢得媒体。
其他选项：A. obsessed with online shopping at certain Web sites.：无中生有。原文没有说消费者沉迷网购。；B. inspired by product-promoting e-mails sent to them.：张冠李戴。发送促销邮件是公司利用自有媒体，不是消费者创造赢得媒体。；C. eager to help their friends promote quality products.：主体关系错位。消费者是向朋友推广自己喜爱的产品，不是帮助朋友去推广朋友的产品；原文也未限定“优质”。
2011-text3-31.evidence: Consumers passionate about a product may create “earned” media by willingly promoting it to friends, and a company may leverage “owned” media by sending e-mail alerts about products and sales to customers registered with its Web site.

2011-text3-32.explain:
正确项：strong user traffic. 定义句直接说出售媒体是流量强大到足以吸引其他机构投放内容或电商系统的自有媒体，核心特征就是强劲的用户流量。
其他选项：A. a safe business environment.：无中生有。environment 只指媒体平台环境，没有“安全”含义。；B. random competition.：文中提到竞争性产品，但没有说竞争是随机的，也不是出售媒体的定义特征。；D. flexibility in organization.：无中生有。文章未讨论组织结构的灵活性。
2011-text3-32.evidence: We define such sold media as owned media whose traffic is so strong that other organizations place their content or e-commerce engines within that environment.

2011-text3-33.explain:
正确项：can be used to produce negative effects in marketing. 赢得媒体依靠消费者参与形成，而同样的技术和用户参与也可能使品牌的媒体资产或营销活动被劫持，迅速放大负面意见，给营销造成破坏性后果。选项概括的是这种由正向传播转为负面作用的风险。
其他选项：A. invite constant conflicts with passionate consumers.：constant 绝对化。文中只说存在风险，并未说赢得媒体不断引发冲突。；C. may be responsible for fiercer competition.：偏离段落重点。第三段讨论负面舆情和控制权被夺走，不是竞争加剧。；D. deserve all the negative comments about them.：对象和态度均错误。负面指控针对品牌或产品，作者也没有说这些指控全部合理。
2011-text3-33.evidence:
The same dramatic technological changes that have provided marketers with more (and more diverse) communications choices have also increased the risk that passionate consumers will voice their opinions in quicker, more visible, and much more damaging ways.
Such hijacked media are the opposite of earned media: an asset or campaign becomes hostage to consumers, other stakeholders, or activists who make negative allegations about a brand or product.

2011-text3-34.explain:
正确项：responding effectively to hijacked media. 丰田用相对迅速、组织周密的社交媒体行动直接接触消费者，并减轻了召回危机的部分损害，是企业有效回应被劫持媒体和负面舆情的例子。
其他选项：B. persuading customers into boycotting products.：主体倒置。号召抵制的是负面消费者，丰田在设法减轻损害。；C. cooperating with supportive consumers.：原文只说直接与消费者互动，没有限定这些消费者支持丰田，也不是案例核心。；D. taking advantage of hijacked media.：偷换目的。丰田是在危机后回应并止损，不是利用劫持媒体获取优势。
2011-text3-34.evidence: Toyota Motor, for example, alleviated some of the damage from its recall crisis earlier this year with a relatively quick and well-orchestrated social-media response campaign, which included efforts to engage with consumers directly on sites such as Twitter and the social-news site Digg.

2011-text3-35.explain:
正确项：Alternatives to conventional paid media. 首段明确提出传统付费媒体之外存在多种替代形式，全文继而依次介绍赢得媒体、自有媒体、出售媒体以及被劫持媒体的运作、收益与风险，因此主旨是传统付费媒体的替代选择。
其他选项：B. Conflict between hijacked and earned media.：范围过窄。两者关系只在第三段出现，无法覆盖自有媒体和出售媒体。；C. Dominance of hijacked media.：无中生有。被劫持媒体被描述为风险，并未占据主导地位。；D. Popularity of owned media.：范围过窄且重点错误。文章介绍多类媒介，没有论证自有媒体最流行。
2011-text3-35.evidence:
The rough guide to marketing success used to be that you got what you paid for.
No longer.
While traditional “paid” media - such as television commercials and print advertisements - still play a major role, companies today can exploit many alternative forms of media.
Consumers passionate about a product may create “earned” media by willingly promoting it to friends, and a company may leverage “owned” media by sending e-mail alerts about products and sales to customers registered with its Web site.

2011-text4-36.explain:
正确项：happiness in retrospect. 西尼尔把幸福称为 a past-tense condition，并说当下压低情绪的育儿经历日后可能带来强烈满足与喜悦，因此这种幸福是在回顾中体会到的。
其他选项：A. temporary delight.：时间关系错误。文中不是短暂快乐，而是当下艰难、日后获得满足。；B. enjoyment in progress.：与原文相反；日常育儿过程可能 soul-crushingly hard。；D. lasting reward.：过度推断。文章说日后可能成为满足来源，没有强调回报一定持久。
2011-text4-36.evidence:
Rather than concluding that children make parents either happy or miserable, Senior suggests we need to redefine happiness: instead of thinking of it as something that can be measured by moment-to-moment joy, we should consider being happy as a past-tense condition.
Even though the day-to-day experience of raising kids can be soul-crushingly hard, Senior writes that “the very things that in the moment dampen our moods can later be sources of intense gratification and delight.”

2011-text4-37.explain:
正确项：having children is highly valued by the public. 报刊摊上几乎每周都反复出现微笑的明星妈妈、准妈妈和理想化母婴形象；下一段随即把这一现象概括为社会 persistently celebrates procreation，说明公众高度推崇生育。
其他选项：A. celebrity moms are a permanent source for gossip.：permanent 绝对化，且第二段重点是母婴形象的高频呈现，不是八卦来源是否永久。；B. single mothers with babies deserve greater attention.：把事实报道偷换成价值主张。文章没有说她们“应当”获得更多关注。；C. news about pregnant celebrities is entertaining.：无中生有。文章只说此类新闻频繁，没有评价其娱乐性。
2011-text4-37.evidence:
The magazine cover showing an attractive mother holding a cute baby is hardly the only Madonna-and-child image on newsstands this week.
Practically every week features at least one celebrity mom, or mom-to-be, smiling on the newsstands.
In a society that so persistently celebrates procreation, is it any wonder that admitting you regret having children is equivalent to admitting you support kitten-killing?

2011-text4-38.explain:
正确项：are constantly exposed to criticism. 社会持续歌颂生育，无子女者则不断被“孩子是世上唯一最重要之物”的信息所困扰，并被暗示其痛苦源于没有孩子。这体现他们持续承受外界的否定和批评。
其他选项：B. are largely ignored by the media.：与原文无关。文章说他们被社会信息困扰，不是被媒体忽略。；C. fail to fulfill their social responsibilities.：作者没有认同这种道德判断，只是在批评社会压力。；D. are less likely to be satisfied with their life.：把社会的反讽性暗示当成事实结论。作者没有说无子女者实际更不满意。
2011-text4-38.evidence:
In a society that so persistently celebrates procreation, is it any wonder that admitting you regret having children is equivalent to admitting you support kitten-killing?
Unhappy parents rarely are provoked to wonder if they shouldn't have had kids, but unhappy childless folks are bothered with the message that children are the single most important thing in the world: obviously their misery must be a direct result of the gaping baby-size holes in their lives.

2011-text4-39.explain:
正确项：misleading. 杂志把单亲明星育儿呈现得轻松幸福，却隐去她们拥有全天候帮助的事实；这与研究和真实育儿负担明显不符，因此传递的是误导性信息。
其他选项：A. soothing.：无中生有。文中没有说这些信息能安抚读者。；B. ambiguous.：并不含糊；杂志明确塑造了轻松、幸福的育儿形象，问题在于失真。；C. compensatory.：词义不符。报道没有补偿某种损失，而是在掩盖实际支持条件。
2011-text4-39.evidence:
Of course, the image of parenthood that celebrity magazines like *Us Weekly* and *People* present is hugely unrealistic, especially when the parents are single mothers like Bullock.
No shock there, considering how much work it is to raise a kid without a partner to lean on; yet to hear Sandra and Britney tell it, raising a kid on their “own” (read: with round-the-clock help) is a piece of cake.

2011-text4-40.explain:
正确项：Celebrity moms have influenced our attitude towards child rearing. 作者认为，明星母亲所展示的无压力、增进幸福的育儿图景，可能在潜意识中抬高我们对育儿的预期，进而加重对真实体验的不满；这说明它们影响了公众对育儿的态度。
其他选项：A. Having children contributes little to the glamour of celebrity moms.：文章讨论的是明星形象如何影响公众，不是孩子对明星魅力的贡献大小。；C. Having children intensifies our dissatisfaction with life.：因果主体错位。可能加重不满的是理想化媒体形象与现实的落差，不是“有孩子”本身。；D. We sometimes neglect the happiness from child rearing.：偏离末段。该段强调理想化形象抬高期待，没有说人们忽视育儿中的幸福。
2011-text4-40.evidence: But it's interesting to wonder if the images we see every week of stress-free, happiness-enhancing parenthood aren't in some small, subconscious way contributing to our own dissatisfactions with the actual experience, in the same way that a small part of us hoped getting “the Rachel” might make us look just a little bit like Jennifer Aniston.

2011-partb-41.explain: G 末句说美国大学里正在发生某种奇怪的事，梅南德把它捕捉了下来；B 紧承其后，用 His concern is mainly with the humanities 说明他关注的对象，再以人文学科“正在过时”的数据和“通识教育”难以界定展开，是全文的话题段。
2011-partb-41.clue: His concern → Menand；the humanities；going out of style → 22% business vs. 2% history

2011-partb-42.clue: such courses → general education；hard to design and teach

2011-partb-43.explain: E 末句说各学科不仅垄断知识的生产，也垄断“知识生产者的生产”；A 以 No disciplines have seized on professionalism with as much enthusiasm as the humanities 把话题收窄到人文学科，用律师三年、医生四年与文科博士九年的对比说明其专业化程度之高。
2011-partb-43.clue: professionalism → the humanities；lawyer in three years vs. nine years for a PhD

2011-partb-44.explain: A 末句说多达一半的英语博士生拿不到学位就退学，C 以 Equally unsurprisingly 承接这一“不令人意外”的事实，进一步指出即使拿到学位，也只有约一半的人能获得当初读研时想要的教职。
2011-partb-44.clue: Not surprisingly → Equally unsurprisingly；half drop out → only about half end up with professorships
